conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.facing: the keeper faces the rig's forward direction (toward the bowler); left/right are the keeper's own - for a right-handed batter the keeper's LEFT is the off side
conventions.positions: ball_at_event_m / bails_m are relative to the keeper's feet at frame 1: forward (toward the bowler), left, up
conventions.standing_up: in the standing-up and run-out clips the stumps are 0.62 m in front of the keeper and 0.28 m to his right (bails 0.71 m high)
conventions.ball: attach the ball to the gloves (RightHand) from event_frame; for the fumble it spills at ball_spills_frame
conventions.left_handed_batters: for a left-hander the off side swaps: use the _legside clips for balls outside the left-hander's off stump and vice versa
conventions.chaining: takes start from the matching stance loop and end standing with the ball at the chest; wk_return_ball_to_bowler starts from that pose
